skill.name: pdf
skill.description: Process PDF documents with Python and command-line workflows for text extraction, tables, forms, merging, splitting, OCR, and PDF generation.
skill.summary: Guide Claude through practical PDF extraction, editing, form filling, and generation workflows.
skill.author: Cam10001110101

security_audit.summary: Most static detections are false positives from markdown backticks, Python f-strings, comments, and documentation URLs. The remaining confirmed issues are expected local filesystem reads and writes used to create, modify, split, merge, and fill PDFs; no prompt injection, hidden network behavior, credential access, or malicious intent was found.

remediation.issue: The skill frequently writes output files from examples and helper scripts.
remediation.suggestion: Require users to choose explicit output paths and warn before overwriting existing files.

remediation.issue: Documentation includes command-line examples for qpdf, pdftk, poppler, and OCR tools.
remediation.suggestion: Clarify that commands should be reviewed before execution and should only run on trusted local documents.

remediation.issue: Form-filling scripts process user-supplied PDFs and JSON files.
remediation.suggestion: Validate input paths and keep generated images, JSON, and PDFs in a dedicated working directory.

content.value_statement: PDF work often requires many libraries and exact file workflows. This skill gives Claude practical steps for extraction, editing, form filling, OCR, and document generation.
actual_capabilities: Extract text and tables from PDFs using pypdf and pdfplumber examples.
Create new PDFs and reports with reportlab workflows.
Merge, split, rotate, crop, watermark, encrypt, and decrypt PDF files.
Convert PDF pages to images for visual review and OCR workflows.
Fill both interactive PDF forms and non-fillable forms using helper scripts.
Validate form bounding boxes before adding annotations to PDFs.
limitations: Requires local Python packages or command-line tools that may not be installed.
Scanned PDFs need OCR and may produce imperfect text extraction.
Complex forms require manual visual validation of field positions.
The helper scripts read and write local files, so output paths must be reviewed.

use_cases.title: Fill application forms
use_cases.description: Extract fields, map user answers, validate coordinates, and create a completed PDF form.

use_cases.title: Extract document data
use_cases.description: Pull text, tables, images, and metadata from PDFs for review or downstream analysis.

use_cases.title: Prepare PDF batches
use_cases.description: Merge, split, rotate, crop, watermark, or encrypt groups of PDF documents.

prompt_templates.title: Extract text from a PDF
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the PDF skill to extract readable text from this PDF. Tell me which tool you will use and save the result as a text file.

prompt_templates.title: Merge and split documents
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the PDF skill to merge these PDFs in order, then split the final document into separate files by section.

prompt_templates.title: Fill a PDF form
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the PDF skill to check whether this PDF has fillable fields, extract the field information, and create a filled version from my answers.

prompt_templates.title: Analyze a scanned form
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the PDF skill to convert this scanned PDF to images, identify form entry boxes, validate bounding boxes, and add the requested annotations.

output_examples.input: Extract all tables from a quarterly report PDF.
output_examples.output: A spreadsheet-ready table set, with page numbers and notes for rows that need manual review.

output_examples.input: Fill a non-fillable PDF intake form from supplied answers.
output_examples.output: A completed PDF plus validation images showing where each answer was placed.

output_examples.input: Merge three PDFs and add password protection.
output_examples.output: A single merged PDF with encryption applied and a short summary of the files included.

best_practices: Keep source PDFs, generated images, JSON files, and outputs in a dedicated working folder.
Visually inspect validation images before writing annotations to a final PDF.
Use OCR only when normal text extraction fails or the PDF is scanned.
anti_patterns: Do not run command examples on unknown PDFs without reviewing the file paths first.
Do not assume extracted text preserves reading order for complex layouts.
Do not skip bounding-box validation when filling non-interactive forms.

faq.question: Can this skill fill interactive PDF forms?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes steps to detect form fields, extract field metadata, validate values, and write a filled PDF.

faq.question: Can it fill scanned or non-fillable forms?
faq.answer: Yes. It converts pages to images, guides visual field mapping, validates bounding boxes, and adds text annotations.

faq.question: Does it require installed dependencies?
faq.answer: Yes. Some workflows need packages such as pypdf, pdfplumber, reportlab, pdf2image, or command-line tools.

faq.question: Can it extract tables?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill provides pdfplumber workflows for extracting tables and converting them into structured data.

faq.question: Does it send PDF data to external services?
faq.answer: No evidence found. The reviewed scripts perform local file processing and contain only documentation links.

faq.question: What should users check before running it?
faq.answer: Users should review input and output paths, confirm dependencies, and inspect generated validation images for forms.
